EventGeneration.title: EventGeneration

EventTimestamp.title: EventTimestamp

JsonRpcError.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 error object, with the Logos error taxonomy in data.
JsonRpcError.title: JsonRpcError

JsonRpcId.description: A JSON-RPC request id; a reply echoes it.
JsonRpcId.title: JsonRpcId

LogosResult.description: A LIDL result. A provider that ran and failed answers success=false here: an application failure is a successful call, never a JSON-RPC error.

error.description: The failure message as a string; null when there is none.

value.description: The payload; any JSON value, null when absent.

LogosResult.title: LogosResult

NoParams.description: No parameters: an empty object or an empty array.
NoParams.title: NoParams

ProviderRejection.description: The provider refused the call and said why. It arrives as the call's result, not as a JSON-RPC error.

code.description: Known codes: dispatch_failed (the argument values were refused), invalid_args (wrong argument count), unknown_method (reserved; not emitted yet). Treat any other code as a refusal too.

ProviderRejection.title: ProviderRejection

SubscriptionState.description: registered: the upstream subscription is held and arms when the provider appears. active: this connection already held the id, so nothing new was registered and nothing is delivered twice.
SubscriptionState.title: SubscriptionState

info.description: The WebSocket endpoint of the Logos JSON-RPC bridge. Operations are the bridge's: it receives requests, each answered by a reply carrying the result or an rpc.error, and it sends event notifications and subscription terminations. Replies are correlated with requests by the JSON-RPC id, events by the caller-assigned subscription id. Module methods use the `<module>.<method>` alias of rpc.call, typed from the module's canonical LIDL contract when it has one (x-logos-untyped marks names-only modules). The other bridge operations (rpc.call, rpc.schema, rpc.ping, ...) are described by rpc.discover.
info.title: Logos JSON-RPC bridge

rpc.subscription_terminated.description: The provider went away or was replaced by a different build, so the subscription ended rather than silently resuming with a gap. Subscribe again (with any id) to resume, and refetch state.
rpc.subscription_terminated.summary: Tell a subscriber its subscription ended.
rpc.subscription_terminated.title: rpc.subscription_terminated

rpc.unsubscribe.description: Stops the subscription with this caller-assigned id. Idempotent: an unknown id is acknowledged too.
rpc.unsubscribe.title: rpc.unsubscribe

bridge.description: Loopback only. Text frames only; Host and Origin are checked on the upgrade.

x-logos-ws-close-codes.description: Binary frame refused: the bridge accepts text frames only.
x-logos-ws-close-codes.name: unsupported_data

x-logos-ws-close-codes.description: Bridge stopped: connections are dropped without a close frame. 1006 is what a client reports; it is never sent.
x-logos-ws-close-codes.name: abnormal_closure

x-logos-ws-close-codes.description: Outbound queue overflow: more than max_queued_frames_per_connection (256) frames were waiting. A slow reader is closed rather than silently missing events.
x-logos-ws-close-codes.name: policy_violation

x-logos-ws-close-codes.description: Inbound message larger than max_frame_bytes (1048576 bytes).
x-logos-ws-close-codes.name: message_too_big
